tools.name: search_recalls
tools.description: Search vehicle safety recall notices from seven national and European registers (NHTSA, Transport Canada, DVSA, EU Safety Gate, RDW, MLIT, Israel) by recall number, make and model, or a plain-language description of the problem in any language (e.g. "brakes fail on 2019 Honda CR-V"). Returns titles and CarsMultiverse URLs to cite.

query.description: A recall number such as 25V455, a make and model such as "ford f-150", or a description of the fault in plain words.

tools.name: get_recall_notice
tools.description: Get one recall notice kept by CarsMultiverse: title, summary, register, dates, an excerpt of the notice and a citation. Pass a recall number or a CarsMultiverse URL or path.

tools.name: check_vehicle
tools.description: Check one vehicle for safety recalls: by VIN (decoded worldwide with NHTSA vPIC), or by make, model and model year. Returns every American recall campaign that may cover it (with do-not-drive and park-outside warnings, and whether the wording was rewritten after publication) plus matching notices from the Canadian, British, EU, Dutch, Japanese and Israeli registers.

plate.description: Number plate (Netherlands or Israel only): returns the recalls still open on that exact vehicle.

tools.name: ask_record
tools.description: Ask a plain-language question about a car and its safety recalls ("does the 2019 Toyota RAV4 have an airbag recall?", "is it safe to drive a 2015 Ford Mustang?"). The make, model, year and subject are read out of the question and the answer is built from the record by fixed rules: sentences with counts, the matching American recall campaigns with do-not-drive and park-outside warnings, and links. No language model writes the answer.

question.description: The question, in plain words. Name the make, model and model year when known.

tools.name: compare_vehicles
tools.description: Compare two cars by their US recall record: distinct NHTSA recall campaigns since 2012, do-not-drive and park-outside campaigns, and a 0-100 recall load, plus the campaign count for one model year when a year is given. Counts, not a safety rating.

a.description: First car as make/model or make/model/year in lower case with hyphens, e.g. toyota/rav4/2019.

b.description: Second car, same form, e.g. honda/cr-v/2019.

tools.name: this_week
tools.description: What entered the recall record in the last seven days: stop-driving and park-outside warnings (US and UK), new US notices, new UK recalls, and official notices that were rewritten after publication.

tools.name: list_registers
tools.description: List the seven recall registers CarsMultiverse keeps, with their authorities and index pages.
